functions._comment_ignore: DO NOT add 'lib' here. functions/lib/ holds the esbuild artifact that functions/scripts/bundle.mjs produces from the ROOT project (services/, shared/) during predeploy. Those sources live OUTSIDE functions/, so they are never uploaded and Google's own build cannot recreate lib/ in the cloud. Ignoring lib/ therefore uploads a package whose main (lib/index.js) does not exist, and the deploy fails with exactly that message. lib/ stays gitignored (build output) but MUST be uploaded.
